messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT P1: XR-HEALTH (tenant_xr_health) sustained 95th pct token-latency > 2.5s acrossDedicated-pool-eu-west-1. Paging eng-oncall.
Aisha (oncall): saw alerts. Observability dashboard shows steady increase around 09:04 UTC. Impact: API error rate ~1.8% and tail latency. Customer on Dedicated/VPC. Prioritized — paging SREs and runtime.
Jon L: I'm on it. Can someone confirm which scheduler config this tenant is pinned to? I remember bespoke knobs for xr-health.
Priya S: They were on bespoke-scheduler-4 with max_batch_tokens=4096 and min_batch_fill=0.2 per last handoff (ticket INF-983). Links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tenant-bespoke
Marta G: Confirmed. Dedicated pool: dp-euwest-03, shard 7. We also have a small reserve pool dp-euwest-spare-1.
Aisha (oncall): quick assessment — is this a cold-start spike or sustained throughput change from the customer? Any change in request rate? 
Jon L: Checking metrics... (grep) their requestQ is 3x baseline, but per-request token lengths are normal. Seems sustained Q-length growing causing oversized batches -> KV cache pressure.
Priya S: Logs show a backlog in the tenant queue and repeated enqueueing of large sequences. Example error lines:
```
2026-03-15T09:05:22Z tenant=tenant_xr_health enqueue_size=318 avg_seq_len=2048 queue_depth=702
2026-03-15T09:06:01Z scheduler drop_attempt=0 max_batch_tokens=4096 active_batches=18
```
Aisha (oncall): status: need mitigation path. Options: 1) Lower max_batch_tokens for tenant, 2) Increase max concurrent batches (risk cost), 3) Route burst traffic to spare pool, 4) Temporarily enable strict per-tenant queue cap (shed). Which is fastest to apply?
Marta G: Easiest immediate: apply gating to limit tenant's inflight request concurrency and reduce max_batch_tokens to 1024 for this tenant. That will reduce KV pressure. I can push change to private config. ETA ~2-3m.
Jon L: Also we should open a canary route to dp-euwest-spare-1 for new requests. I'll flip the routing flag but keep a 10% sample first.
Priya S: Note — lowering max_batch_tokens may increase token-costs slightly (more batches) but reduces tail latency. Acceptable tradeoff per SLA.
Aisha (oncall): do the actions. I'll notify support and customer success. Include a rollback plan.
Marta G: applying change now: patching tenant config ->
```
PATCH /configs/tenants/tenant_xr_health
- max_batch_tokens: 4096
+ max_batch_tokens: 1024
+ queue_cap: 600
+ enable_rate_gating: true
```
ops-runner-bot: config deploy job started: job_id=cfg-deploy-87621
ops-runner-bot: job status: running on dp-controlplane-eu-west
Jon L: routing flip: set routing.policy.tenant_xr_health.spillover = dp-euwest-spare-1 (sample_fraction=0.1)
incident-bot: NOTE: Deploys & routing changes may take up to 30s to propagate to all schedulers.
Aisha (oncall): monitor 1/3/5/10 min windows. Priya, support ping sent to the account rep.
Priya S: Confirmed, CS pinged: message sent to customer with basic summary and ETA.
Marta G: ops-runner-bot reports config deploy success: job_id=cfg-deploy-87621 status=success. Propagation completed to 95% of schedulers.
Jon L: I'm observing queue depth dropping and active_batches reducing. 95th pct latency trending down from 2.7s -> 1.1s within 90s.
Aisha (oncall): nice. Keep observation for 15m. If we see requeueing or error spikes, we'll escalate to full tenant isolation and drain.
Priya S: support update: customer reports degraded UX earlier but now seeing improvement. They asked what changed — told them we applied temporary gating and are monitoring.
Marta G: making follow-up adjustments: bump queue_cap to 500 and keep max_batch_tokens=1024. Also enabling backpressure metric alerts.
Jon L: I've increased the spillover to 25% for new traffic to spare pool; not touching existing sessions.
Aisha (oncall): timeline + decisions to capture for postmortem: 09:04 alert, 09:06 identify queue growth, 09:08 patch applied, 09:10 latency reduced, 09:25 stable -> begin de-escalation.
incident-bot: Handoff reminder: please create an incident ticket with root-cause hypothesis and customer impact summary. Tag: P1#XR-HEALTH. Pager duty handoff — next oncall is Priya in 15m.
Priya S: I'll take follow-up. I'll keep gating for 2 hours and prepare a gradual rollback plan to 2048 max_batch_tokens once traffic normalizes. Will also schedule dedicated perf test with tenant sample traffic replay.
Aisha (oncall): thanks everyone. Marking thread as active, will update in 15m. :thumbsup:
Marta G: adding runbook note and config diff to the incident ticket.
incident-bot: INCIDENT P1 updated: state=mitigated impact=partial latency reduced, customer_reached_outcome=improving \"
